name: decko-ts-pbkdf2
description: The decko-ts adapter (adapters/ts) under the port's default password policy: new passwords stored as PBKDF2 and a legacy SHA-1 digest replaced at sign-in. Grade it with --declared-divergences reference-harness/adapters/ts-pbkdf2/declared-divergences.json; only the password digest value may differ from the oracle.
